Definition: something round, i.e. a ring (for the ears)
BiblicalUsage: Agiyl is a ring — an earring, something round worn on the ear. After the battle with Midian, the officers of Israel brought their gold jewels, chains, bracelets, rings, and earrings as an offering to the Lord; and in Ezekiel's picture of Jerusalem, God puts earrings in her ears and a beautiful crown on her head.
TheologicalSignificance: An earring offered to the Lord is a gift, not a teaching — the gold matters because it was given, and the verse says why.
